title: Grounding LLM Agents in Business Processes: Process-Aware Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Multi-Step Service Invocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that call enterprise APIs must select the correct endpoints, follow process order, use valid payload keys, and choose coded values from predefined lists. However, current retrieval-augmented service discovery treats endpoints independently and therefore misses process and schema constraints. We address this limitation by integrating Open Data Protocol (OData) metadata and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) reference processes in a typed property graph. A hybrid retriever identifies candidate endpoints using dense embeddings and follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints. We evaluate the method on 42 enterprise services with process-chain ground truth. For queries with low lexical overlap between the query and downstream entities, it improves Recall@3 by 5.7 points (n=74), with consistent gains across embedding models and cut-offs. translated_title: 将大语言模型智能体锚定于业务流程：面向可靠多步骤服务调用的流程感知知识图谱
translated_abstract: 调用企业API的大语言模型（LLM）智能体必须选择正确的端点、遵循流程顺序、使用有效的载荷键，并从预定义列表中选择编码值。然而，当前的检索增强式服务发现方法将端点独立处理，因此忽略了流程和模式约束。我们通过将开放数据协议元数据与业务流程模型和标记法（BPMN）参考流程整合到类型化属性图中来解决这一局限。混合检索器使用稠密嵌入识别候选端点，并沿着流程边检索后续端点。我们在42个企业服务上结合流程链真值对该方法进行评估。对于查询与下游实体之间词汇重叠度较低的查询，该方法将Recall@3提升了5.7个百分点（n=74），且在不同的嵌入模型和截断阈值下均保持一致的增益。在其他查询上，其表现与稠密检索相当，并提供了……
tldr: 该论文提出将OData元数据与BPMN参考流程整合为类型化属性图知识图谱，并利用沿流程边检索的混合检索器，显著提升了LLM智能体在多步骤企业服务调用中的准确性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes integrating OData metadata and BPMN reference processes into a typed property graph, where a hybrid retriever follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints, significantly improving the accuracy and reliability of multi-step enterprise service invocation for LLM agents.
